description: This file implements the GStreamerWebAudioPlayerClient class, which manages audio playback using GStreamer, including opening, closing, playing, pausing, setting end-of-stream, and handling audio buffers. It interacts with a backend to process audio data and manages timers and buffers for streaming audio data.

classes.name: GStreamerWebAudioPlayerClient
classes.description: A class that manages WebAudio playback using GStreamer, handling buffer processing, state management, and interaction with a backend.

methods.name: notifyPushSamplesCallback
methods.description: Callback function invoked when the push samples timer expires, triggers the pushSamples method.

methods.name: parseGstStructureFormat
methods.description: Parses the format string from GStreamer caps to extract sample size, endianness, sign, and float properties.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Comparison operator for WebAudioPcmConfig to check if two configurations differ.

methods.name: GStreamerWebAudioPlayerClient::open
methods.description: Initializes the audio stream based on provided GStreamer caps, creating or updating the backend as needed.

methods.name: GStreamerWebAudioPlayerClient::close
methods.description: Closes the audio stream and releases resources.

methods.name: GStreamerWebAudioPlayerClient::play
methods.description: Starts playback of the audio stream.

methods.name: GStreamerWebAudioPlayerClient::setEos
methods.description: Signals end-of-stream to the backend, processing remaining buffers if any.

methods.name: GStreamerWebAudioPlayerClient::isOpen
methods.description: Checks if the audio stream is open.

methods.name: GStreamerWebAudioPlayerClient::notifyPushSamplesTimerExpired
methods.description: Handles timer expiration to push buffered samples.

methods.name: GStreamerWebAudioPlayerClient::notifyNewSample
methods.description: Handles new incoming GstBuffer samples, adding them to the buffer queue.

methods.name: GStreamerWebAudioPlayerClient::pushSamples
methods.description: Processes buffered samples, writes them to the backend, and manages leftover data.

methods.name: GStreamerWebAudioPlayerClient::isNewConfig
methods.description: Determines if the current configuration differs from the new one, requiring reinitialization.

methods.name: GStreamerWebAudioPlayerClient::notifyState
methods.description: Notifies external callbacks of the current player state.
